name: Sniper's Gambit
author: Agent15
summary: Capturing with a Bishop from 3 or more spaces away skips the enemy's turn.
description: An epic gambit for long-range players: capture with a Bishop from 3 or more spaces away (measured along either axis) and the enemy's next turn is skipped. Needs the Gambit Creation API and the 'Point A' Manager library, both of which install automatically.
